name: porshe
description: Hunts for revenue you have earned but not received — invoices left unpaid, payments in limbo, work delivered and never billed, requests sitting in your inbox with money attached. Narrow by design: it surfaces the gaps rather than chasing anyone, so collection is still your job.

official.title: porshe by Lauren
official.description: Business-money scout. ONLY job: find money the user already has sitting around — unpaid invoices, pending payments, inbound paid asks, uncollected work...
